app_store.name: Footnote: Meeting Notes
app_store.subtitle: Notes you can check, on-device
app_store.promotional_text: Every line of your meeting notes links back to the moment it was said. No account, nothing uploaded, audio saved to your disk as you talk.
app_store.description:
Footnote takes notes in your meetings and keeps everything on your Mac.

Write down what matters to you during the call. Footnote records your microphone and the call's sound, saves it to your disk every 30 seconds, and turns it into a transcript and clear notes on this computer. If the app or the Mac stops mid-call, the note finishes from what was saved.

Check any line
Every generated line carries the time it was said. Click it to open that moment in the transcript. The lines you wrote yourself are marked as yours.

See where every note is
Each note shows whether it is saved, transcribing, writing or ready. If something fails, Footnote says why and offers Try again. Your recording and transcript stay safe.

No account, nothing uploaded
No sign-in. Speech-to-text and note writing run on your Mac with a local model through Ollama. The only network use is your calendar link, if you add one.

Also included
- A pop-up a minute before a meeting starts
- Templates for different kinds of meetings, with a "/" menu while you type
- A real editor for your own notes, and short, normal or detailed notes
- How long every meeting lasted
- Search across titles, notes and transcripts
- Folders, a 30-day trash, and questions about your notes
- Export every note as Markdown, any time

What you need
macOS 14 or later, and Ollama with a model installed. Footnote shows you how. Tell people you are taking notes; recording rules depend on where you are.

Free. No subscription.
